breakdown.description: The opposing horizontal tractions are reinterpreted as boundary-normal loads on the horizontal edges
breakdown.reason: The generated specification applies a traction vector of (1000, 0) on the top edge, which preserves global x-directed horizontal traction interpretation. The known inconsistency required removing the reinterpretation as boundary-normal loads on horizontal edges (as in ground truth, which leaves the original σ_xx=±1000 Pa statement without that reinterpretation). Therefore, this inconsistency was not fixed.
